teaches: evidence or mushroom — confidence is not correctness; only tests and compost pay

TEST.note: first compost pass through the tiny experiment

RESOLVE_FALSE.note: completion compost of a tested-false claim — full value; rejection is compost

RESOLVE_TRUE.note: claim is CARVED instead — permanent lesson, door-key material (long-term value, not instant ZOL)

COMPOST_UNTESTED.note: soil without understanding; residue keeps whispering at the c_phi floor

BELIEVE.note: belief is not work. chalk only, washable, and it can come back to bite

economy.audit: max run = every claim tested and resolved = 8 x 10 = 80 = lambda * total deposits (Law 3, tight)

evidence_ladder.CARVED: tier I — tested true; an ogham stroke is added to the dolmen, permanent

law_staging.law2_whisper: any claim neither tested nor fully resolved keeps >= c_phi salience and WHISPERS during later trials (ambient audio + faint glow on its stone)
law_staging.law1_return: a BELIEVEd untested claim returns as a witness in a later trial; if a dependent claim fails, the chalk visibly washes off in the rain
law_staging.dependency_lesson: trial 2 cites trial 1 chalk: building on untested belief doubles the collapse

trial_structure.trial_2_dependency: one trial-2 claim cites the player's trial-1 BELIEVE choices
trial_structure.trial_3_finale: FRIDGE_SUNSET + one whispering leftover from earlier — the circle remembers what you skipped
